added.description: Incoming documents stored (a repeated id counts each occurrence).

DocIn.description:
One document. `vector` has exactly `--input-dim` finite numbers (omit it only when the server
embeds text on-device).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last page.

score.description: Exact cosine similarity for vector queries; fused rank score for text queries.

text.description: Stored text, empty when the document was stored without text.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, plus the deprecated `error` object kept for v1 SDK clients.

ef.description: Beam width of a graph-index query, 1..=4096 (recall knob). Default: `--query-ef`.

filter.description: Keep documents whose metadata contains every key with an equal JSON value.

index.description:
Route of an unfiltered vector query: `auto` (the graph index when built, else the
exact scan), `exact` or `graph` (409 `index_unavailable` until maintenance built one).
Default: the server's `--query-index`.

query.description: Text query; requires the on-device model stages (`local-models`).

today.description: Date relative times in `query` resolve against (query rewriting).

previous_snapshot.description: The replaced store, kept as a snapshot with this id.

SearchHit.description: One text search hit. `text` and `metadata` are present only when named in `include`.

score.description: BM25 score; the fused rank score when the server runs on-device model stages.

SearchIn.description: A lexical text query over the tenant's documents (memory facts included).

include.description: Extra fields per hit: any of `"text"` and `"metadata"`. Default: ids and scores only.

query.description: 1..=8192 bytes with at least one word.

tenants.description: Tenants with a store on disk.

VectorIndexBody.description: The vector snapshot that answers unfiltered vector queries (see `--query-index`).

current.description:
Whether the snapshot is the live store. A stale snapshot still answers correctly:
deleted and replaced documents are dropped and new ones scored exactly.

graph.description: Whether a graph index is built over the snapshot (`auto` queries use it).

rebuildRecommended.description: Whether the next index maintenance or compaction will capture a fresh snapshot.

rows.description: Embedded chunks the snapshot covers; 0 until maintenance builds one.

staleMutations.description: Inserts, replaces and deletes since the snapshot was captured.

bearerAuth.description: API key. Scopes: read, write, admin (admin includes read and write). Keys are bound to tenants.

info.description: One engine store per tenant. The /api/v1 contract is stable: see docs/server/versioning.md. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.
